title: Huntcore
description: Survive an endless night where hostile mobs never stop hunting you.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/owV6Bj2YEcU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>Huntcore

Huntcore turns Minecraft into a brutal apocalypse survival experience.

When you create a new world, you only have one peaceful day to prepare. During this time, hostile mobs do not spawn, giving you a short chance to gather resources, build a shelter, and get ready.

Once the first night begins, the world changes forever.

The sun never rises again.
Night becomes endless.
Hostile mobs start appearing everywhere.

Mobs are far more aggressive than in normal Minecraft:

Increased detection range
Constant player tracking
Harder survival during the night
Endless pressure and atmosphere of hopelessness
Mobs can break blocks to reach players
Some mobs are able to build toward the player


To help players survive longer, special loot chests appear around the world every 5 minutes. These chests can contain useful resources, food, tools, and other survival items.

The mod is designed to create a darker and more intense survival experience inspired by apocalypse and horror gameplay.
